content.comment_body: Hello, In one of the demo videos for the [product_name] Communication Module, a user sends an SMS command by typing 'FAN ON,' and the module accepts it. Is it possible to set up custom SMS commands, rather than using the default format like 'LOGO=VM,x,x'?
You can customize SMS commands from the module's web server: [url]

This link doesn't provide details on sending custom text commands. I'm asking about sending text without the typical 'LOGO=VM' format. For example, I want to send 'PARKING OPEN' and have the specified output change from 0 to 1.
You need to configure this in the web interface of the [product_name] Communication Module, so it recognizes the symbolic command.
Check the manual on page 98. Please see the attachment.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are attempting to create more intuitive SMS commands for the [product_name] Communication Module, allowing actions with simple symbolic commands instead of complex, technical strings. The main issue is insufficient documentation on enabling these features, which increases confusion and makes integration more difficult.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish to set up and utilize straightforward, customized SMS commands to control module outputs, preferring simple readable formats over complicated, predefined command structures.
